softSkills.title: Leadership and team management
softSkills.text: Group leader for 9 years, I led 3 teams, both in combat units and on the IT side as helpdesk lead.

softSkills.title: Teaching and knowledge sharing
softSkills.text: Regular trainer on IT systems and the military environment, to keep the basics sharp and raise cybersecurity awareness.

softSkills.title: Responsiveness and crisis management
softSkills.text: Quick response to incidents on critical infrastructure to keep operations running, for example: a full C: drive on a mail server taking down the transport service, or a DFS sync that replicated an empty folder instead of the data during a migration (restore from backup and notice to the affected users only, to respect the chain of command).

softSkills.title: Rigour and discipline
softSkills.text: Punctuality, complex decision-making, documentation and written procedures, keeping up with IT news and trends.

softSkills.title: Autonomy and curiosity
softSkills.text: Since leaving the army I keep learning: a professional title earned, self-study with GitHub and a study project on hyperconverged infrastructure. Able to work on-site at customers’ premises with professional conduct, listening to their needs, and to handle all kinds of failures.

softSkills.title: Adaptability
softSkills.text: I have worked in very different conditions: overseas missions, exercises in all weather, working with engineers as a tester, a career change through a work-study programme. I adapt to new environments.

softSkills.title: Team spirit and communication
softSkills.text: Having worked in teams on many projects and on very hard-to-solve incidents, I value teamwork and express myself clearly.

softSkills.title: Service mindset and user focus
softSkills.text: I listen to feedback from users and administrators, improve resolution and maintenance processes, and give users a clear, understandable analysis.
